newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV offers Repsol before prospectus.
newsitem.headline: BBV offers Repsol before prospectus.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) has offered its clients shares in the upcoming Repsol privatisation before the prospectus has been approved, the Stock Market commission (CNMV) said on Friday.
"They cannot offer shares before the prospectus has been approved and we are bringing this to BBV's attention," a CNMV spokesman said.
The government is selling its remaining 10 percent stake in the Spanish energy group. The CNMV is currently reviewing the prospectus ahead of approval.
BBV offered clients a "four percent discount on the average price of the shares on April 28."
Furthermore, the bank indicated in a letter to clients that the privatisation calendar would run from April 7 to 25.
The deadline for placing an order for shares is April 21 at 1200 GMT and clients can revoke their order up until April 24 at 1200 GMT, BBV said in the accompanying sale terms.
The minimum amount requested can be 50,000 pesetas while the maximum is 10 million pesetas, BBV said.
